title: 1904 memory lines move for its people and carriages
items: The memory lines 1904 is held to rise: 1,300 to 1,425 MB on a capable computer, and 400 to 425 MB on a phone. They make room for the people, horse teams and household routines added this week. Computers with built-in graphics now open a lighter town, so the computer line no longer covers the machines that crashed.
